description: cc-bridge: one Claude login for your whole agent. Runs your fork's agent through genuine Claude Code (the real `claude` CLI) with your fork's own identity. Interactive, human-driven use only; send automation (crons/heartbeats/unattended loops) through a metered API key. DO NOT combine with harness-id (tinkerclaw-harness-id): using the two together may breach the terms of an Anthropic subscription. See README.

providerAuthChoices.groupHint: Drive the real Claude Code CLI, inherit subscription OAuth

binary.description: Path to claude binary. Defaults to `claude` on PATH.

cwd.description: Working directory for the claude subprocess. Default: ~/.openclaw/jarvis-workspace if it exists, otherwise OpenClaw's agent workspace (~/.openclaw/workspace, or workspace-<profile>).

disallowedTools.description: Tools to disable inside claude (OpenClaw owns the tool loop). Replaces the permissive default list entirely.

warmOnBoot.description: Session keys to pre-spawn at gateway start (e.g., agent:main:main).

transport.description: How the gateway talks to each claude worker. "pipe" (default): systemd-run --pipe; a gateway restart cuts the turn. "file": a FIFO and output files the worker owns; a restart freezes the worker at an API-call boundary and the next gateway resumes the turn. The env var TINKERCLAW_BRIDGE_TRANSPORT overrides it.

binary.label: Claude binary
binary.help: Absolute path to the claude CLI. Falls back to PATH lookup if blank.

cwd.label: Workspace directory
cwd.help: cwd for each claude subprocess. Used for CLAUDE.md loading and session transcripts.

disallowedTools.label: Disallowed tools
disallowedTools.help: Tools to disable in-claude. The default is PERMISSIVE: it blocks only Agent and Claude Code's IDE/task-UX tools. Bash/Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob stay ENABLED and the subprocess runs with bypassPermissions. Set this list to impose a restrictive profile; your value replaces the default, it does not merge.

name: cc-bridge
